{{Quote|Where do I know the name Selaggis from?''"<br />"''Another Zsinj strike zone. One of the first I looked at after I assumed command of this task force. One of the moons of Selaggis Six was colonized. I guess Zsinj decided to make a lesson of someone colonizing on his border without his permission. ''Iron Fist'' wiped out the whole colony. I think it would be very appropriate if he were wiped out in the same system.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and Han Solo|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''Selaggis VI''', or '''Selaggis Six''', commonly known as '''Selaggis''', was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Selaggis Six is the perfect place for Zsinj to make a stand. He can use the terrain to his advantage. An asteroid ring to hide in, a planetary atmosphere he might even be able to bring ''Iron Fist'' into for cover.|Han Solo, to [[Onoma]]|<ref name="SC" />}}
Selaggis VI was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located within the [[Selaggis system/Legends|Selaggis system]]<ref name="SC" /> of the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]], which connected it to the [[Bandomeer system/Legends|Bandomeer]] and [[Vahaba system/Legends|Vahaba systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Selaggis VI was one of the seven [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Selaggis]]. The planet was orbited by several [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Selcaron]], and was also circled by a heavy [[Asteroid/Legends|debris]] [[Planetary ring/Legends|ring]] thought to have been another moon at one [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="SC" />

Selaggis VI was a beautiful yellow-orange [[Gas/Legends|gas]] giant with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] characterized by constant storm activity. The storms unceasingly changed the planet's patterns of swirls and lines of color, so that each new [[Local day/Legends|day]] offered variations in the worldscape, making it an ever-changing work of art for the [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] on Selcaron.<ref name="SC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Zsinj is trapped at Selaggis.|Han Solo|<ref name="SC" />}}
Selaggis VI was the site of the [[Battle of Selaggis]] between [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="SC" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You saw what the ''Iron Fist'' did on Selaggis. It turned the whole colony into rubble.|Han Solo|<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Planet04-SWR.png|thumb|right|250px|Selaggis in ''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]
Selaggis was introduced in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', written by [[Dave Wolverton]], which mentioned it as the location of a [[Unidentified colony (Selcaron)|colony]] that was [[Attack on Selcaron|obliterated]] by Warlord Zsinj's [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']].<ref name="TCoPL" />

Selaggis then appeared in the [[1998]] PC [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], which described it as a planet with a "favorable climate that has attracted colonists."<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>

The [[1999]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]], later identified the planet as the gas giant Selaggis Six, and [[Retroactive continuity|changed]] the location of the colony to one of its moons, Selcaron.<ref name="SC" />

The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' finally identified the planet as Selaggis VI.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|136|Selaggis, Battle of}}</ref>
